parameters.help_en: The ID of the tracking task to delete. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270043.html operation to query tracking task IDs
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的订阅任务ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270043.html接口查询订阅任务ID
